product.summary: StripeMeter offers 'pre-invoice parity for Stripe usage billing.' This suggests it addresses a specific workflow related to usage-based billing on Stripe, potentially helping businesses reconcile or preview invoices before they are finalized. However, there is insufficient detail to confirm if it automates the workflow end-to-end or acts as an agent making decisions and taking actions, as required by the thesis.
